# Daniela Reinoso | Organizational Effectiveness Consulting

> Daniela Reinoso is an organizational effectiveness professional and independent consultant based in Quito, Ecuador. She helps founders and leadership teams of growing organizations improve how they work through organizational diagnostics, clearer roles and decisions, better processes, and practical systems. She has over a decade of experience in People & Culture, process redesign, and systems implementation, including leading People & Culture for teams across 13+ countries. She works across Ecuador, Latin America, and remotely worldwide, in English and Spanish.

## Services

- [People Systems Snapshot](https://danielareinoso.co/people_systems_snapshot.html): A free, self-guided 3-minute check on where friction may be coming from in an organization's roles, decisions, processes, and people practices.
- [Organizational Effectiveness Primer (OE Primer)](https://danielareinoso.co/primer.html): A one-week session (90-minute working session + 10-minute team questionnaire, 2-page memo) for founder-led teams of roughly 5–15 people deciding which people practices to formalize now, what can stay informal, and what to watch. Investment: USD $1,250 flat.
- [People Systems Assessment (The Scan)](https://danielareinoso.co/scan.html): A three-week organizational diagnostic that maps where roles, processes, and people systems create drag, risk, or confusion, resulting in a 90-day roadmap. It stands on its own; the client chooses whether and how to act on it. Starting at USD $3,500.
- [People Infrastructure Partnership](https://danielareinoso.co/services.html): An optional ongoing partnership to sequence and implement the organizational systems a team's priorities call for. Six-month minimum, priced individually.
